description: Classify company websites from their own pages. Give domains (up to 500) and optionally your own phrases. For each domain the actor reads the homepage and up to 5 linked pages (about, products, services, wholesale, manufacturing, industries, pricing) and returns one row: business_model b2b, b2c, both, or unknown with the signals found; is_saas, is_ecommerce, is_agency, is_manufacturer, is_wholesaler, is_distributor, is_marketplace; phrases_matched and phrases_negated; and top_evidence_text with top_evidence_url quoting the page. Rules are deterministic, no language model. Unreachable, blocked, robots.txt disallowed, and empty sites come back free with a row_status saying so. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN; Apify charges per domain classified.

categories.description: Business categories to test. Empty means all seven.

domain.description: One company domain, for example lodgecastiron.com.

domains.description: Company domains or website addresses, up to 500.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge would pass this amount.

max_pages.description: Pages read per site, homepage included, 1 to 10. Default 6.

phrases.description: Your buyer phrases to look for, for example clay agency or private label. Whole words, plurals included, case ignored; a hit inside a negation does not count. Up to 25.

proxy_mode.description: auto (default) retries a refusing site through the Apify proxy at no extra cost; direct never uses a proxy.

name: classify_website
title: Classify company websites
